svg.title: Added
svg.desc: - keepSignedIn in sites.json, Keep Signed In in each site's … menu in the window, and umbra keep-signed-in [site ...] [--off]: a launch agent (com.randyren.umbra.keep-signed-in) visits the marked sites every 10 minutes, and on wake for a visit missed while the Mac slept, so a site that ends idle sessions on its side, like Canvas, keeps you signed in. It implies keepSession, and each run logs one line per site to ~/Library/Application Support/Umbra/keep-signed-in.log.
